four_term_disclosure.both_triples_or_neither: A coverage figure may not be published without all four terms. §11.5, and the reason it is a rule rather than a habit: every threat class in §1.7 ends in a number that travelled alone.

note: Task 23. The opening record is 5Q-F013, inherited by digest with 5R's vpf_disposition beside 5Q's own quoted disposition. Everything after it is 5R's, including the records against 5R itself: §7.3 exists because 5Q's twelve findings all named another stage while its own harness defects were narrated in prose.

opening_finding.content_is_not_re_derived: Inherited by digest. Not re-worded, not re-classified, not renumbered. 5R adds one field of its own and touches nothing else — 5Q's `disposition` is quoted above, never replaced.
opening_finding.expected_result: the Q0/Q1 lifecycle admits an incomplete Q0: Q0 freezes what actually happened, and Q1 is authorised to repair the harness as well as the code
opening_finding.observed_result: Q0 is frozen and T3 and T7 are false. Q1 is gated on them. The declared phase table is exhaustive — Q0_PREPARATION, Q0_DISCOVERY, Q0_TRANSITION, Q1 — and of the phases still reachable, none may produce the artifacts those conditions require: T3 needs 'coverage_evidence'; T7 needs 'harness_repairs'. Q0_TRANSITION is validation-only by declaration and produces no evidence; Q0_DISCOVERY ended when the freeze was signed and re-entering it would rewrite frozen evidence. The state has no legal outgoing transition.
opening_finding.q0_disposition_quoted: Published here and inherited by the successor stage. Stage 5Q is NOT reopened. The 6.2% coverage figure and the twelve-record ledger stand exactly as signed.
opening_finding.vpf_disposition: 5R IS the lawful outgoing transition. F013's deadlock is a property of 5Q's phase table, and 5R is not in it: a new stage produces new evidence under its own contract without reopening a frozen one.

records.affected_artifact: docs/research/llm-shield/evidence/stage-5q/mutation/receipts.json + the L4 admissibility rule that consumes it
records.expected_result: a green→red→green mutation receipt for class R is evidence that class R is detectable over the members where R is claimed to apply
records.not_a_repair: 5Q's ledger is not reopened and its receipts are not re-run. This is a 5R record about a 5Q artifact, the same relationship 5Q had to 5M.
records.observed_result: each receipt is evidence over exactly one member, in one role. Across the fourteen discharged classes the tested role holds 2 118 of 20 213 obligated cells — 10.5%. Four populated roles totalling 699 members received no mutation evidence at all; of the 26 (role, class) obligations they carry, 22 were discharged class-wide on evidence earned in another role.
records.why_not_stronger: no published 5Q coverage number depends on it. status_tally shows attacked_pass: 0, so the weak generalisation never propagated into the 6.2%. The defect is in the assurance argument, not the arithmetic, and any stronger severity would be an overclaim — this finding exists to make an overclaim harder, not to commit one.

records.claim_narrowed: 5R demonstrates an instrument, not coverage. The tranche's contribution to cumulative coverage is exactly zero and the ledger says so in the same relationship as every other figure.
records.declared_before_the_run: the bound is written into the module that produces the result, not appended to it afterwards, and a unit test asserts no cell can reach the discharged state through this probe.
records.expected_result: a tranche of admissible families discharges some of the obligation cells its pairs contain
records.observed_result: all eight T1 families are admissible and all 2406 cells of their pairs were probed, and ZERO were discharged. The probe is static; clause 10 requires the class-specific outcome matched on this member; a static reading cannot demonstrate an outcome that was never executed.

records.expected_result: the detector decides by the declared signal, which is a property of the code under test
records.observed_result: it decided by the presence of a marker comment naming the declared signal — a marker the control's own author places. Under it vulnerable-detected and safe-not-detected held by construction, all seven §4.1 conditions passed, and none of it was about a defect.
records.repaired_by: core/signals.mjs; mutant N7 seeds this exact defect and the census catches it
